authority: CBCC Phase 2 Advertising Optimization consumer accounting

locked_behavior.first_class_object: Advertising Optimization is a business authority independent from Product Image/Asset Universe/Paid Campaign materialization. Mature tools.ads remains the deterministic performance calculator; Phase 2 adds authored optimization decisions and verified commercial boundaries rather than replacing the calculator.
locked_behavior.economics_rule: Ads consumes only the verified Phase 2 Economics/Offer authority. CPA/ROAS require their explicit economics inputs; CPC additionally requires explicit CVR. Missing economics never becomes zero or a scale signal.
locked_behavior.offer_rule: The Ads row offer must match the verified Phase 2 Offer Decision. A different discount/bundle/promotion remains TO_VERIFY until Economics/Offer authors it.
locked_behavior.economics_binding_rule: Each optimization row explicitly binds spend decisions to phase2_economics_offer_authority.break_even; generic text saying 'within economics' does not satisfy the binding.
locked_behavior.test_rule: A/B intent must expose one test_variable, hold_constant set, success_rule and failure_rule in machine-auditable fields; generic test prose alone cannot close the test contract.
locked_behavior.attribution_rule: Platform attribution never equals incrementality. Causal sales/lift claims require both a defensible counterfactual result from the mature analyzer and an explicit authored incrementality decision; a self-declared ESTABLISHED label cannot bypass missing counterfactual evidence.
locked_behavior.no_performance_rule: An explicit Ads Optimization plan can materialize before historical performance exists. The runtime writes NO_AD_PERFORMANCE_DATA_SUPPLIED, does not call the metrics calculator, leaves metrics empty and platform attribution NOT_SUPPLIED, while still validating the authored business plan against Economics/Offer.
locked_behavior.input_integrity_rule: The internal no-performance stub is request-local and temporary. It is removed after consumption, or the user's original ad_analysis configuration is restored exactly; empty ad_data is not treated as measured zero performance.
locked_behavior.canonical_rule: ADS canonical authority prefers the enriched existing ad_analysis.json. paid_campaign_architecture.json remains a later fallback/consumer and does not substitute for Phase 2 Ads Optimization.

verified_behavior: Advertising Optimization business readiness is separate from legacy CALCULATED/PORTFOLIO_CALCULATED metric-analysis status.
A mature Ads metric result cannot false-pass a missing Agent-authored optimization decision.

Each optimization row requires objective/funnel/audience/tension/creative mechanism/proof/offer/landing/spend boundary/attribution/test/failure diagnosis/smallest repair/learning handoff plus six-field WHAT/WHY/EVIDENCE/TRADEOFF/EXECUTION/MEASUREMENT density and REQ-088 lineage.
A/B optimization exposes a named test variable, hold-constant set, success rule and failure rule instead of relying on generic testing prose.

Ads consumes verified Phase 2 Economics/Offer values; missing economics keeps business readiness TO_VERIFY, while missing CVR only keeps break-even CPC unavailable when CPA/ROAS remain valid on their own inputs.
Ads offer must align with the verified Phase 2 Offer Decision and cannot silently invent a launch discount/bundle/promotion.
Every row carries an explicit Economics authority reference for spend/scale boundaries.
Platform-attributed conversions do not establish incrementality. Causal sales claims remain disabled without mature counterfactual evidence plus an explicit authored incrementality decision.
Unknown source IDs remain visible and unresolved; they cannot satisfy Ads REQ-088 lineage.
Direct and portfolio Ads analyzers consume the Pricing/Economics context exactly once; portfolio internal analyze_ads calls cannot steal the context before aggregate analysis.
Pricing/analyzer exceptions clear request-local context so a failed project cannot contaminate a later Ads call.
An explicit Ads Optimization plan with no performance data still materializes before asset work as NO_AD_PERFORMANCE_DATA_SUPPLIED; no metrics are fabricated or defaulted to zero.
Empty ad_data is not treated as observed zero performance. Temporary materialization stubs restore the user's original ad_analysis configuration after consumption.
Seven-tool Advertising Optimization exposes business_readiness_status separately from legacy project_status.
Canonical ADS prefers enriched ad_analysis.json over later paid_campaign_architecture.json, preserving one first-class Ads authority.
